cohort: The study included 39 patients diagnosed with Grade 1 endometrial cancer without myometrial invasion (G1EA) or atypical endometrial hyperplasia (AEH) who received MPA treatment.
finding: Medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) treatment was found to be effective for both initial and recurrent atypical endometrial hyperplasia (AEH) and Grade 1 endometrial cancer (G1EA), achieving high complete response rates.
